text_block_list.text:
Today is the day we depart for summer 
training camp. However, Vodka is still 
nowhere to be found.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Vodka sure is taking her sweet time. Did 
she crash while pretending to ride an air 
bike or something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As for Vodka-san, she was saying something 
about 'ditching' or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Like I'd ever waste my time with some 
half-assed training camp with a bunch of 
teammates," she'd said.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, after getting that fired up in the 
Derby, you're still keeping up the fashion 
punk act...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, who're you calling a fashion punk, 
huh?!

And so, with Vodka on board after suddenly 
tagging along for some reason, the bus 
headed straight for the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew, we have arrived. It was quite a 
bumpy ride, but the air is truly 
refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So, Vodka. Why the sudden decision to 
join?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...My old man lectured me. Said, 
'Summer's meant for hangin' with your buds 
and searchin' for gems.'"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If Pops says so, there's no doubt about 
it. That's why I came.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Well, even if we're jewels, hanging out 
casually with you guys is fine, but count 
me out of any romance talk."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I really can't tell whether you're 
contrary or straightforward, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So yeah, I'll be counting on you at the 
training camp too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Slacking off too much will make your body 
dull. Let's hit the training hard, too.
Raising a hand lightly, a promise is made.

Vodka had gradually begun opening up to 
her friends. After the fierce spring 
battles, she seemed to have grown a bit 
more mature.
